selection_note: London venue prospects for a filmed 45-90 minute house or electronic warm-up set. Short open-decks nights are excluded. Priority combines visual backdrop, music fit and a credible programming, collaboration or hire route.
safety_note: No venue has granted a set or filming permission. Every opportunity requires written approval for the performance, filming, crew, audience capture, music use and commercial YouTube publication. Published equipment is stated only where verified.

opportunities.genres: House, disco, soulful and electronic
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Independent plant-filled canalside bar, kitchen and music venue with a terrace overlooking the River Lea.
opportunities.opportunity: Pitch a 45-90 minute early-evening or quiet-night filmed warm-up set through the official contact/private-hire route.
opportunities.equipment: Music production is established, but no dependable public DJ inventory was found. Request exact deck, mixer and monitor specifications.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official current site describes the canalside bar, kitchen and live-music venue and publishes contact, private-hire and Canalside Sessions routes.
opportunities.next_action: Send a visual one-page concept for a sunset canalside session, minimal crew and a 60-minute soulful-house mix.
opportunities.constraint: Written filming approval is required; agree towpath framing, neighbours, audience releases, power and weather contingency.

opportunities.schedule: Closed production session or collaborative filmed set
opportunities.genres: Leftfield electronic, house and experimental
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Raw industrial unit with concrete, exposed structure and credible underground warehouse character.
opportunities.opportunity: The venue explicitly accepts photo and video production enquiries, making a controlled 45-90 minute session unusually realistic.
opportunities.equipment: Production facilities are available, but the current fixed DJ inventory is not publicly itemised.
opportunities.evidence_note: The official site directs photo and video productions to shoot@ormside.co.uk and publishes a separate general contact route.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a two-hour closed shoot including setup, a 60-minute set, minimal lighting and a clean promotional edit for the venue.
opportunities.constraint: Likely a paid production or collaboration. Confirm sound limits, lighting, insurance, crew access and YouTube rights.

opportunities.genres: Electronic, club nights and creative programming
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Distinctive converted public-baths complex with café, bar, hall and raw community-space character.
opportunities.opportunity: The venue invites people to bring their own events and is a plausible route for a filmed warm-up or standalone session.
opportunities.equipment: The hall publishes a full Martin Audio system; exact DJ players and mixer must be confirmed.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official pages publish the café/bar/cultural venue, its bring-your-own-event route and the hall's Martin Audio system.
opportunities.next_action: Offer a weekday 60-minute filmed set that also gives Eastway Baths a venue promo edit.
opportunities.constraint: Written filming and music approval required; confirm which room, sound curfew, power and whether hire fees apply.

opportunities.genres: DJs, club nights and music-industry programming
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Independent recording-studio bar with a large courtyard, industrial brickwork and an established creative-industry crowd.
opportunities.opportunity: Its official enquiry route explicitly accepts DJ/Artist and Promoter enquiries, supporting a proper warm-up pitch rather than open decks.
opportunities.equipment: The adjoining studios are world-class, but the bar's current DJ booth inventory is not published.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official pages list DJs, club nights and a dedicated DJ/Artist or Promoter enquiry route.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a courtyard golden-hour session or early support set with one 60-minute house mix and compact two-camera plan.
opportunities.constraint: Secure approval for cameras, customer capture and any recording-studio branding; confirm external sound limits.

opportunities.genres: Electronic, house, club and eclectic DJ programming
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Iconic compact central-London music bar with mural-lined, low-lit interiors and two distinct DJ spaces.
opportunities.opportunity: The official venue route invites DJ, night and residency proposals, making a proper early set plausible.
opportunities.equipment: Downstairs: 2× CDJ-2000NXS2, DJM-900NXS2 and 2× Technics 1210s. Ground floor: 2× CDJ-900NXS, DJM-750MK2 and 2× PLX-1000.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official programming pages invite DJ/night/residency proposals and the current technical specification publishes both booths.
opportunities.next_action: Send a tailored 45-60 minute warm-up concept with one mix and explain how filming stays unobtrusive.
opportunities.constraint: The set and filming need separate written approval; a venue-specific concept will outperform a generic request.

opportunities.genres: House, disco, techno and electronic
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Bold colour-blocked industrial complex with warehouse, courtyard and container-style architecture.
opportunities.opportunity: A private-hire route makes an off-hours filmed session plausible; promoter support is the alternative route for a public warm-up.
opportunities.equipment: Professional club production is evident, but confirm the current player, mixer and monitor package directly.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official current site publishes electronic programming and private-hire/contact routes.
opportunities.next_action: Propose a daytime courtyard or warehouse shoot and offer a short venue-focused promo edit.
opportunities.constraint: Confirm hire costs, cameras, lighting, artwork, customer releases and music playback/recording rights.

opportunities.genres: Electronic and cross-genre live programming
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Atmospheric railway arches with exposed brick, intimate stage and strong permanent lighting.
opportunities.opportunity: The official private-hire route makes a controlled 45-90 minute filmed performance more plausible than seeking an unsolicited public slot.
opportunities.equipment: Professional venue production is available; request the current DJ package and audio-recording options.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official site publishes a dedicated private-hire route for the railway-arch venue.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a two-hour closed daytime shoot with a 60-minute set, minimal crew and venue credit throughout.
opportunities.constraint: May require paid hire. Confirm filming, insurance, lighting control and whether recorded audio can be taken from the desk.

opportunities.genres: Soulful/deep house, disco, Afro-house and selectors
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Intimate record-lined hi-fi bar with warm timber, vinyl and a distinctive listening-room aesthetic in Copeland Park.
opportunities.opportunity: A musically specific low-key warm-up or selector session is more credible here than a peak-time club pitch.
opportunities.equipment: The venue foregrounds its custom hi-fi/listening-bar sound; a complete current DJ booth inventory is not public.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official site publishes current selector programming, bookings and contact routes.
opportunities.next_action: Attend first, then pitch a tasteful 45-60 minute deep/Afro-house session designed around the room's listening culture.
opportunities.constraint: Small footprint means compact cameras and controlled guests. Obtain permission before filming patrons or record artwork.

opportunities.schedule: Sunset garden opener or early arch set
opportunities.genres: House, disco and electronic
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Railway arches, tropical garden, covered terrace and dramatic lighting create several strong visual looks.
opportunities.opportunity: The venue's active programme and hire/contact routes make a proper sunset or early support set plausible, subject to programming approval.
opportunities.equipment: Professional club setup is used; exact current CDJ and mixer models should be confirmed.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official pages publish house/electronic programming plus venue-hire and contact routes.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a golden-hour garden set with an option to continue into an early arch warm-up and provide the venue with promo clips.
opportunities.constraint: Confirm railway noise, public-operation window, brand partners, audience releases and camera positions.

opportunities.genres: Rooftop DJs, house, disco and eclectic electronic
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Open rooftop with broad East London skyline views and a relaxed day-to-night atmosphere.
opportunities.opportunity: Its official contact/private-hire route supports a sunset-session proposal, though no performance has been offered.

opportunities.evidence_note: Official current site advertises rooftop DJs and provides contact/private-hire routes.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a 45-60 minute golden-hour set with weather backup, wind-safe cameras and a skyline-led edit.
opportunities.constraint: Written approval needed for commercial filming, guests and skyline use; confirm wind, weather, power and sound limits.

opportunities.genres: House, disco and electronic rooftop parties

opportunities.opportunity: Approach the relevant promoter or official events team for an early rooftop support slot and filming collaboration.
opportunities.equipment: No dependable public technical specification was verified.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official programme publishes current DJ-led rooftop events and contact routes.
opportunities.next_action: Identify a matching promoter from the current programme and pitch a filmed 45-minute opener with a shared promotional edit.
opportunities.constraint: Admission does not grant filming permission. Confirm cameras, guest releases, weather, power and any event-brand restrictions.

opportunities.genres: DJs, party programming and eclectic dance music
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Seasonally themed rooftop installation with City and Shoreditch views, bold décor and strong night lighting.
opportunities.opportunity: The venue's official events and contact routes provide a path to its music bookings team.
opportunities.equipment: No current public booth specification was verified for unsolicited performers.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official current pages feature DJs across the rooftop/bar programme and publish contact routes.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a seasonal visual concept tied to the current rooftop design and a 45-60 minute early-evening house set.
opportunities.constraint: Secure written permission for filming, seasonal artwork, customer capture, tripods and commercial YouTube use.

opportunities.genres: House, disco and electronic selectors
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Brick Lane industrial café-bar with bespoke booth, warm warehouse interior and a recognised independent music identity.
opportunities.opportunity: Retain as a direct venue pitch, not as its short On Wax open-decks listing.
opportunities.equipment: Bespoke hand-built DJ booth and Klipsch/Tannoy hybrid sound system; confirm players, mixer and monitors.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official venue pages publish regular DJs, a bespoke booth, sound system and direct contact route.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a quiet weekday 60-minute filmed house session with a Brick Lane/venue story and polished promotional clips.
opportunities.constraint: The venue must approve filming, customer capture, brand use and exact set window; the previous open-decks route has been removed.

opportunities.genres: Vinyl selectors, disco, soulful and deep house
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Stylish neighbourhood restaurant and listening bar with a warm vinyl-led interior that transitions into dancing.
opportunities.opportunity: A restrained dinner or early-evening selector set is more plausible than a club-style pitch.
opportunities.equipment: No current model-level booth specification was verified.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official current programme lists regular DJs and contact/event enquiry routes.
opportunities.next_action: Attend first, then propose a tasteful 45-minute vinyl or deep-house warm-up that suits the food-to-dance transition.
opportunities.constraint: Small room and diners make filming sensitive. Request a controlled early slot and avoid capturing guests without consent.

opportunities.genres: Vinyl, soul, disco and intimate electronic selectors
opportunities.visual_backdrop: Tiny hidden basement cocktail bar with warm vintage sound, concrete textures and a cinematic low-lit interior.
opportunities.opportunity: Best pitched as a tightly defined listening session during a controlled period rather than a busy public night.
opportunities.equipment: Official site advertises DJ equipment and its sound-led environment; request exact current models.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official site confirms the operating bar, music events, DJ equipment and contact/private-hire routes.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a closed or pre-opening 45-minute deep-house session with minimal lighting and two compact cameras.
opportunities.constraint: Very limited space. Confirm paid hire, crew size, lighting, audio capture and strict customer privacy.

opportunities.schedule: Closed daytime Art Deco theatre shoot

opportunities.next_action: Pitch a two-hour closed shoot with a 60-minute melodic-house set and strong venue storytelling.

opportunities.equipment: Request current DJ playback and recording capabilities through venue hire.
opportunities.evidence_note: Official site publishes a venue-hire route for the historic club.
opportunities.next_action: Pitch a heritage-led filmed session with minimal crew, venue history in the edit and clear promotional value.
opportunities.constraint: Stretch target. Expect brand approval, hire cost and restrictions on logos, audience and commercial publication.

opportunities.opportunity: Realistically a paid hire, sponsor, label or media partnership rather than a free newcomer set.
